title: settings.json allows the commands a headless sprint runner and its manager run
goal: permissions.allow in .claude/settings.json holds the rules a headless /kb-sprint run needs, each as a Bash rule with a PowerShell mirror: python3 _tools/kbgit.py *, python3 _tools/selfdoc.py stale *, git fetch, status, log, show, diff, add, commit, rebase, merge-base, checkout, branch, cherry, worktree and -C, glab mr view and glab mr merge; the tools Agent, Edit, Write and SendMessage; and for the manager python3 _tools/autopilot.py *. Operator decision recorded on gate permissions: add all as listed. The exact rule texts are in TK-3hphkfbg's notes at commit 4ba521801. A test named settings_allow_headless_runner reads settings.json and asserts each rule and its mirror, and no rule beyond the list.

gates.question: Add the allow rules a headless sprint runner and its manager need to .claude/settings.json?
options: add all as listed (Bash rules with PowerShell mirrors, tools Agent Edit Write SendMessage, manager autopilot.py)
a narrower set without git checkout, branch, worktree and glab mr merge

gates.recommendation: add all as listed (Bash rules with PowerShell mirrors, tools Agent Edit Write SendMessage, manager autopilot.py)
gates.answer: add all as listed (Bash rules with PowerShell mirrors, tools Agent Edit Write SendMessage, manager autopilot.py)
